name: dsh-ui
description: DeepSeek Harness Lightweight Desktop Client (macOS & Windows & Linux)
author: xtxo

scripts.build:mac: npm run icons && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin
scripts.build:mac-arm64: npm run icons && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:mac-x64: npm run icons && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:windows: npm run icons && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
